architectural_observation: The email record supports a layered HR technology environment with payroll/tax, benefits/carrier, state reporting, communications and recruiting functions split across different services. Current authoritative ownership by data domain must be mapped before automation writes to any external system.
transition_observation: May-June 2026 messages show movement toward a shared HR identity while the historical individual HR mailbox remained operational in several systems. Treat mailbox/account migration and recovery ownership as an explicit transition to validate rather than assuming it is complete. Earlier benefits-carrier history now includes Baptist Health Plan, Humana, The Abacus Group and a 2018 Humana installation kickoff; this should be treated as historical version context rather than current provider authority. Attachment evidence proves UnitedHealthcare plan involvement by 2021, so the 2026 'recent implementation' language may represent a new plan/configuration/account transition rather than first-time UHC adoption.
